items.text: Enforced a strict 9‑cow herd cap that applies to all ages, unborn calves, and includes a configurable cap on potential for unbred animals, preventing oversized herds.
Recessive livestock genes now affect market prices and trigger NPC comments, with UI hints highlighting hidden traits.

Comprehensive cow overhaul: clearer ownership display, trust UI, defensive behavior for females, removal of old‑age death, crowding‑only death, milk charge and cooldown UI, pregnancy and feeding UI, language‑based naming, and dedicated performance budgeting.
Old animals such as bears, stags, boars, and chickens no longer sleep, now flee when shot, and bears no longer sprint at high speed.
Fixed livestock breeding and feeding reach issues and restored petting functionality with correct rotation handling.

Fixed several Tool Cupboard issues: items no longer auto‑grant on the tutorial island, map markers now appear only on appropriate maps, and the TC label no longer shows a stray delete button after updates.
Splash damage now respects walls and line of sight, and projectiles no longer collide with ragdoll bodies, preventing rockets from detonating near dead NPCs.
Boomerang now correctly damages BaseNPC2 enemies.
PT turrets (including boat turrets) now retain ammo after restarts, support reload animations for all ammo types, can be reloaded mid‑session, and related UI toasts are fixed.
Vending UI now correctly limits sell order stack size and shows accurate stack multipliers when hovering items.
Boomerangs now deal the intended damage after a damage calculation fix.
Storage boxes no longer block placement against walls, fixing placement issues.
Vending machine UI interactions are more reliable, resolving purchase glitches.
Cows no longer clip through walls, preventing heads from protruding out of buildings.
Triangle frames and foundations are now correctly visible when placed.
Players no longer auto‑crouch when near closing doors or animated blocks, improving movement.
Console command autocomplete now suggests the correct realm, reducing mistyped commands.

2026-10-08.summary:
### Livestock & Animal Systems
- Enforced a strict 9‑cow herd cap that applies to all ages, unborn calves, and includes a configurable cap on potential for unbred animals, preventing oversized herds.
- Recessive livestock genes now affect market prices and trigger NPC comments, with UI hints highlighting hidden traits.
- Comprehensive cow overhaul: clearer ownership display, trust UI, defensive behavior for females, removal of old‑age death, crowding‑only death, milk charge and cooldown UI, pregnancy and feeding UI, language‑based naming, and dedicated performance budgeting.
- Old animals such as bears, stags, boars, and chickens no longer sleep, now flee when shot, and bears no longer sprint at high speed.
- Fixed livestock breeding and feeding reach issues and restored petting functionality with correct rotation handling.

### Tool Cupboard & Map UI
- Fixed several Tool Cupboard issues: items no longer auto‑grant on the tutorial island, map markers now appear only on appropriate maps, and the TC label no longer shows a stray delete button after updates.

### Combat & Damage
- Splash damage now respects walls and line of sight, and projectiles no longer collide with ragdoll bodies, preventing rockets from detonating near dead NPCs.
- Boomerang now correctly damages BaseNPC2 enemies.

### Turrets & Weaponry
- PT turrets (including boat turrets) now retain ammo after restarts, support reload animations for all ammo types, can be reloaded mid‑session, and related UI toasts are fixed.

### UI & Building Improvements
- Vending UI now correctly limits sell order stack size and shows accurate stack multipliers when hovering items.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Boomerangs now deal the intended damage after a damage calculation fix.
- Storage boxes no longer block placement against walls, fixing placement issues.
- Vending machine UI interactions are more reliable, resolving purchase glitches.
- Cows no longer clip through walls, preventing heads from protruding out of buildings.
- Triangle frames and foundations are now correctly visible when placed.

### Quality of Life
- Players no longer auto‑crouch when near closing doors or animated blocks, improving movement.
- Console command autocomplete now suggests the correct realm, reducing mistyped commands.

items.text: A new 'potential' stat tracks an animal’s average happiness, influences vendor sale prices and prevents selling animals with zero potential; the value rises or falls over time based on current happiness.
Animals now dismount to the nearest valid spot with a physics check to avoid clipping through structures, and players receive toast notifications when mounting or dismounting fails due to obstacles.
PT Boat turrets now support full viewmodels, reload functionality, corrected rear turret aiming, and smoother rendering to eliminate stutter.
Mortar fire is now synchronized for all players, ensuring consistent behavior.
Weapon shot settings have been corrected, improving firing reliability.
Grenade throw velocity has been increased, allowing grenades to travel farther.
A biofuel generator pooling bug was fixed, restoring reliable fuel production.
Horse animations and behavior were fixed: horses now sleep correctly, dismounted horses no longer keep their heads turned, and animation pooling issues are resolved.
A crash triggered by ore flare devices has been resolved, improving overall game stability.
Tool cupboards no longer appear on the map when the max tool cupboard limit is disabled at runtime.
Viewmodel skins are restored and work correctly again.
The wounded first‑person sound now plays in builds (volume reduced by 50%).
Gun jitter is eliminated when turning animations are playing.
Harbor bridge and crane sounds no longer play on initial load.
RC computer screen blur issue fixed.
Spectator viewmodel drop animations now play correctly.
Added a sound effect when selling wool or animals, providing audible confirmation of the transaction.
Fixed a crash that occurred when copying and pasting invulnerable entities, allowing seamless duplication.

2026-10-07.summary:
### Animals & Livestock
- A new 'potential' stat tracks an animal’s average happiness, influences vendor sale prices and prevents selling animals with zero potential; the value rises or falls over time based on current happiness.
- Animals now dismount to the nearest valid spot with a physics check to avoid clipping through structures, and players receive toast notifications when mounting or dismounting fails due to obstacles.

### Weapons & Combat
- PT Boat turrets now support full viewmodels, reload functionality, corrected rear turret aiming, and smoother rendering to eliminate stutter.
- Mortar fire is now synchronized for all players, ensuring consistent behavior.
- Weapon shot settings have been corrected, improving firing reliability.
- Grenade throw velocity has been increased, allowing grenades to travel farther.

### Power & Generators
- A biofuel generator pooling bug was fixed, restoring reliable fuel production.

### Mounts & Horses
- Horse animations and behavior were fixed: horses now sleep correctly, dismounted horses no longer keep their heads turned, and animation pooling issues are resolved.

### Stability & Crash Fixes
- A crash triggered by ore flare devices has been resolved, improving overall game stability.

### Bug Fixes
- Tool cupboards no longer appear on the map when the max tool cupboard limit is disabled at runtime.
- Viewmodel skins are restored and work correctly again.
- The wounded first‑person sound now plays in builds (volume reduced by 50%).
- Gun jitter is eliminated when turning animations are playing.
- Harbor bridge and crane sounds no longer play on initial load.
- RC computer screen blur issue fixed.
- Spectator viewmodel drop animations now play correctly.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added a sound effect when selling wool or animals, providing audible confirmation of the transaction.
- Fixed a crash that occurred when copying and pasting invulnerable entities, allowing seamless duplication.
